gloss: to burst out laughing; to roar with laughter

definitions.gloss: to burst out laughing; to roar with laughter
definitions.explanation: To laugh loudly and uncontrollably. Originally meant a large group laughing together, but in modern usage commonly refers to any instance of explosive, unrestrained laughter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{爆笑|ばくしょう}した。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{爆笑|ばくしょう}してしまった。
examples.english: I burst out laughing watching that video.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おもしろすぎて、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{爆笑|ばくしょう}してしまった。
examples.english: His story was so funny that I burst out laughing on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}んだ→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧。
examples.english: That comedian had the entire venue in stitches.

notes:
Originally, ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧ strictly meant a large group of people laughing simultaneously (the {爆|ばく} = "explosion" suggesting laughter spreading through a crowd). However, modern usage has shifted, and it now commonly describes any intense, explosive laughter — even by one person. This semantic shift is noted by language purists but widely accepted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧: to elicit roaring laughter
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧: whirlpool of laughter
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧もの: something hilarious
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧⟦エピソード→エピソード：10729_episoodo⟧: hilarious anecdote
- {大|おお}⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧: huge burst of laughter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to laugh — general-purpose laughing
- ⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to laugh heartily — loud laughter, slightly less explosive
- ⟦{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す→吹き出す：06342_fukidasu⟧: to burst out laughing — sudden laughter, often from trying not to laugh
